items.question: How does an AI tattoo generator work?
items.answer: Upload a photo of the body part you want tattooed, describe your tattoo idea, and our AI generates a custom design then places it realistically on your photo. You'll see previews on all 4 body positions (left arm, right arm, shoulder, calf).

items.question: How many free previews can I try?
items.answer: Explore the real interactive example for free. New accounts receive 3 one-time credits after email verification. A complete set costs 1 credit at 1K, 2 at 2K, or 3 at 4K. Buy more credits on the pricing page when needed.

items.question: How realistic are the previews?
items.answer: A tattoo simulator gives you a visual approximation of a design on your photo. AI may also change pose, skin or background details. Compare the output with your original, and ask a tattoo artist to assess the design and placement.

items.question: How long does generation take?
items.answer: Processing time varies with resolution and provider demand. The current workflow generates a standalone design and four body-placement previews. You can return to History to check progress.

items.question: What photo should I upload?
items.answer: A clear, well-lit photo of the body area where you want the tattoo. Avoid baggy clothing that covers the area. The better the photo, the better the preview.

items.question: Can I use the generated design at a tattoo shop?
items.answer: Use the design and photo preview as references for a conversation with a tattoo artist. The artist should check linework, size and placement and adapt the concept before tattooing.

items.question: Can I generate minimalist or geometric tattoo designs?
items.answer: Yes. Describe the subject, style and composition in your prompt, such as a minimalist botanical line drawing or a black-and-grey geometric wolf. AI output varies; check the details before using it as a reference.
